integrity: All reported chain ranks, signed characters, group actions and decomposition multiplicities are reproducibly computed from explicit graph data with exact integer operations. Independent mathematical audit has not been performed.
scientific_limitations: Determines rational homology representations of the twelve-vertex icosahedral graph matching complex under its full finite automorphism group; not the integral group-module lattice, torsion action, quotient integral cohomology, or equivariant homotopy type. A published nonequivariant homotopy classification is not claimed as new. Publication priority against all unindexed literature is not established.
title: Complete rational icosahedral symmetry of the torsion-bearing matching complex
